name: binomial_fisher_exact_two_sample
description: Two-sample exact Fisher test, p0=0.05 vs p1=0.15, one-sided greater, alpha=0.05, 80% power, equal allocation. Unconditional power mixes the conditional hypergeometric rejection rule over S=X0+X1; minimal n0=n1=126 (total 252); n0=125 (125+125=250) gives 0.79779 and fails.

reference.provenance: Independent double enumeration over (x0,x1) tables with scipy.stats.hypergeom, not using ssp.kernels
